hotelDesc.overview:
Experience Modern Comfort at Citadines Central Binh Duong

Welcome to Citadines Central Binh Duong, a contemporary 4-star hotel located in the vibrant city of Bình Dương, Vietnam. With its convenient location, this hotel offers easy access to the airport, city center, and numerous attractions. Built in 2018 and last renovated in the same year, Citadines Central Binh Duong boasts 204 well-appointed rooms, providing a comfortable and stylish retreat for both business and leisure travelers. Upon arrival, guests can check-in from 02:00 PM and begin their memorable stay. The hotel's modern design and warm hospitality create a welcoming ambiance, ensuring a pleasant experience from the moment you step through the doors. The spacious and elegantly furnished rooms offer a tranquil haven, equipped with all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay. Citadines Central Binh Duong is located approximately 70 minutes away from the airport, allowing for convenient travel arrangements. The hotel's proximity to the city center, just 30km away, provides easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Whether you're exploring the vibrant streets of Bình Dương or attending business meetings, this hotel serves as an ideal base for your adventures. Families traveling with children will appreciate the hotel's child policy. Children between the ages of 2 to 6 can stay free of charge, making Citadines Central Binh Duong a family-friendly choice. Additionally, the hotel allows up to two pets per room, ensuring that your furry friends can join in on the fun. Indulge in modern comfort and convenience at Citadines Central Binh Duong. With its prime location, stylish rooms, and thoughtful amenities, this hotel offers a truly enjoyable stay in Bình Dương, Vietnam.

Unwind and Connect at Citadines Central Binh Duong's Shared Lounge and TV Area

At Citadines Central Binh Duong, we understand the importance of relaxation and connection during your stay. That's why we offer a shared lounge and TV area for our guests to unwind and socialize. Step into our inviting shared lounge, furnished with comfortable sofas and armchairs, where you can sink into plush cushions and enjoy a moment of tranquility. Whether you want to catch up on your favorite TV shows, read a book, or simply have a chat with fellow travelers, our lounge provides the perfect space to do so. Our TV area is equipped with a large flat-screen TV, offering a wide range of channels and entertainment options. Sit back and enjoy a movie night with your loved ones or catch up on the latest sports events. The cozy ambiance of the lounge and the state-of-the-art facilities in the TV area ensure that you have a memorable and enjoyable experience at Citadines Central Binh Duong.

Stay Active at Citadines Central Binh Duong's Sports Facilities

At Citadines Central Binh Duong, staying active and maintaining your fitness routine is made easy with an array of sports facilities. Dive into the refreshing outdoor pool, perfect for a leisurely swim or a quick dip to beat the heat. The pool area is surrounded by lush greenery, providing a tranquil oasis where you can relax and unwind after a long day of exploring Binh Duong. For those who prefer a more intense workout, the hotel offers a complimentary fitness center equipped with state-of-the-art exercise machines and equipment. Whether you're looking to do some cardio on the treadmill, lift weights, or engage in a full-body workout, this fitness center has everything you need to stay in shape during your stay. With its modern facilities and dedicated staff, Citadines Central Binh Duong ensures that you can maintain your fitness routine and achieve your health goals while enjoying your time in Binh Duong.

Convenience Facilities at Citadines Central Binh Duong

At Citadines Central Binh Duong, guests can enjoy a range of convenience facilities that cater to their every need. The hotel offers safety deposit boxes, ensuring that guests can securely store their valuables during their stay. The friendly and attentive concierge staff are always on hand to assist with any inquiries or requests, providing a personalized and seamless experience for every guest. For those who need to stay connected, Wi-Fi is available in all public areas of the hotel, allowing guests to easily access the internet and stay connected with loved ones or catch up on work. The hotel also offers designated smoking areas for guests who smoke, ensuring a comfortable stay for both smokers and non-smokers. In addition, Citadines Central Binh Duong provides free Wi-Fi in all rooms, allowing guests to stay connected and browse the web from the comfort of their own space. Luggage storage is available for guests who need to store their belongings before check-in or after check-out. For added convenience, the hotel features a convenience store on-site, perfect for grabbing snacks or any essentials guests may need during their stay. Lastly, the hotel offers daily housekeeping services, ensuring that guests can enjoy a clean and tidy room throughout their stay. With these exceptional convenience facilities, Citadines Central Binh Duong ensures a comfortable and hassle-free stay for all guests.

Convenient Transport Facilities at Citadines Central Binh Duong

At Citadines Central Binh Duong, guests can enjoy a range of convenient transport facilities that make exploring the vibrant city of Bình Dương a breeze. The hotel offers an airport transfer service, ensuring a hassle-free journey to and from the airport. Whether you are arriving or departing, you can relax knowing that your transportation needs are taken care of. For guests who prefer to drive, Citadines Central Binh Duong provides a car park onsite. With self-parking available, you can conveniently park your vehicle and explore the city at your own pace. The best part is, the car park is free of charge, allowing you to save on additional expenses. If you prefer to leave the driving to someone else, the hotel also offers a shuttle service and taxi service. Whether you need to get to a business meeting or explore the nearby attractions, these transportation options are readily available. With these transport facilities, Citadines Central Binh Duong ensures that guests have a seamless and enjoyable stay.

Indulge in Delectable Dining at Citadines Central Binh Duong

At Citadines Central Binh Duong, guests can enjoy a delightful culinary experience with a range of dining facilities available on-site. Start your day with a scrumptious breakfast buffet at the hotel's stylish restaurant. The restaurant offers a wide selection of international and local dishes, ensuring there is something to please every palate. For those looking for a quick bite or a casual meal, the hotel also features a cozy café. Here, guests can savor a variety of light snacks, sandwiches, and refreshing beverages. Whether you are in the mood for a cup of freshly brewed coffee or a delicious pastry, the café provides the perfect spot to relax and recharge. In addition to the restaurant and café, Citadines Central Binh Duong also offers room service for guests who prefer to dine in the comfort of their own rooms. With a diverse menu featuring both local and international cuisine, guests can enjoy a private dining experience without leaving their accommodation. The hotel's dedicated staff ensures that every meal is prepared and delivered promptly, allowing guests to enjoy a hassle-free dining experience throughout their stay.

Spacious and Comfortable Rooms at Citadines Central Binh Duong

Experience the ultimate comfort and relaxation at Citadines Central Binh Duong with their range of spacious and well-appointed rooms. Choose from a variety of room types to suit your preferences and needs. The One Bedroom Deluxe offers a generous space of 54 square meters, featuring a comfortable Queen Bed. For even more space, the One Bedroom Executive provides 60 square meters of room to unwind, also with a Queen Bed. If you're looking for a touch of luxury, the One Bedroom Premier offers a spacious 63 square meters, complete with a Queen Bed. For those who prefer a more compact yet cozy accommodation, the Studio Executive is an excellent choice. With 35 square meters, it offers either a Queen Bed or two Single Beds. If you desire more space, the Studio Premier provides 50 square meters of room to relax and rejuvenate. Traveling with family or friends? The Two Bedroom Executive is perfect for you. With a generous area of 71 square meters, it offers the flexibility of two Single Beds or one Queen Bed.
